quiz.question_id: Mengapa `User` dan `NewUser` bisa diakses dari package lain, tetapi `password` dan `hashPassword` tidak?
quiz.question_en: Why can `User` and `NewUser` be accessed from another package, but `password` and `hashPassword` cannot?
options_id: Karena identifier yang diawali huruf kapital exported, sedangkan huruf kecil unexported
Karena hanya struct dan constructor yang boleh diakses lintas package
Karena field dan helper function selalu private di Go
Karena `user` adalah package khusus untuk autentikasi
options_en: Because identifiers starting with an uppercase letter are exported, while lowercase ones are unexported
Because only structs and constructors may be accessed across packages
Because fields and helper functions are always private in Go
Because `user` is a special package for authentication

`fmt.Println(u.Username)`
`fmt.Println(u.password)`
`fmt.Println(u.CheckPassword("secret123"))`
options_en: `fmt.Println(u.ID)`

quiz.question_id: Mengapa contoh memakai method exported `CheckPassword` alih-alih mengekspos field `password` secara langsung?
quiz.question_en: Why does the example use the exported `CheckPassword` method instead of exposing the `password` field directly?
options_id: Agar package menjaga detail internal dan memberi API validasi yang aman
Agar method bisa diakses tanpa import package
Agar field string bisa berubah menjadi int
Agar constructor tidak perlu mengisi password
options_en: So the package can protect internal details and expose a safer validation API
So the method can be accessed without importing the package
So the string field can change into an int
So the constructor no longer needs to set the password

quiz.question_id: Apa manfaat utama fungsi unexported seperti `hashPassword` di dalam package?
quiz.question_en: What is the main benefit of an unexported function like `hashPassword` inside the package?
options_id: Menjamin fungsi akan inline oleh compiler
Menyembunyikan detail implementasi sehingga bisa diubah tanpa mengubah API publik
Mencegah fungsi dipanggil dari file lain dalam package yang sama
Memaksa semua password disimpan plaintext
options_en: It guarantees the compiler will inline the function
It hides implementation details so they can change without changing the public API
It prevents the function from being called by other files in the same package
It forces all passwords to be stored in plaintext

quiz.question_id: Jika sebuah field struct diawali huruf kecil, di mana field itu tetap bisa diakses?
quiz.question_en: If a struct field starts with a lowercase letter, where can it still be accessed?
options_id: Di package mana pun selama memakai pointer
Hanya di package yang sama
Hanya di `main` package
Tidak bisa diakses bahkan dari package sendiri
options_en: In any package as long as a pointer is used
Only within the same package
Only in the `main` package
It cannot be accessed even from its own package

quiz.question_id: Mengapa guideline lesson menyarankan 'export as little as possible'?
quiz.question_en: Why does the lesson guideline recommend 'export as little as possible'?
options_id: Karena exported API lebih sulit diubah tanpa mempengaruhi pengguna package
Karena exported code tidak bisa dites
Karena unexported code selalu lebih cepat
Karena package dengan banyak export tidak bisa di-compile
options_en: Because exported API is harder to change without affecting package users
Because exported code cannot be tested
Because unexported code is always faster
Because packages with many exports cannot compile

State sensitif disembunyikan, lalu diakses melalui method publik yang terkontrol
Package tidak boleh punya helper function internal
Encapsulation berarti semua field harus immutable

Sensitive state is hidden and accessed through controlled public methods
A package may not have internal helper functions
